MANUFACTURING PARTNER · QINGYUAN, GUANGDONG

Production collaboration with Guangdong Zhengutang.

AURVONX projects are coordinated by Guangzhou Huanyue and manufactured with Guangdong Zhengutang Biotechnology Co., Ltd. when the selected project is within the partner’s confirmed scope.

Qingyuan cosmetics manufacturing base

Production Workshop No. 60, Zhongxing Guangqing Zhigu, No. 287 Yinying Highway (Yuantan Section), Yuantan Town, Qingcheng District, Qingyuan City, Guangdong, China.

The partner’s supplied documents identify cosmetics GMP/ISO 22716 coverage for general liquid and cream units, including shampoo, skincare liquid, hair gel, skincare/cleanser cream and haircare.

“From product selection to documentation, each project starts with a confirmed scope.”

AURVONX project principle

Factory history and local context

Guangdong Zhengutang Biotechnology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2023 according to public company information and operates in Qingyuan’s growing beauty-manufacturing cluster. In a 2025 report about Qingyuan’s “beauty economy”, the company’s quality and safety representative described receiving one-to-one guidance from the local cosmetics industry service station to organize filing materials and support a product launch.

This public report describes local industry support and the company’s participation in a filing process. It does not establish a universal production capacity, export count, customer count or product success rate.
